_comment: 2024 candidate roster, second half of the year (API max 10). The 2024 board is the pre-election seven: Karl Schmidt president, Vital Anne vice president, Gary Hauff secretary, with Alic, Haupt, Philippart and Wilson as trustees — Melton, Potts and Zendler were not seated until January 2025. Business Services changed hands mid-year: Rick West (also Board Treasurer for 2024) presents through the spring; Daniel Trudel is in the seat by the September 17 meeting. Use speakers_2024_h1.json for meetings before that changeover. Kris Griffor (Assistant Superintendent, Elementary Instruction) and Kendra Montante (Director, Communications & Strategic Initiatives) are frequent presenters who do not fit inside the 10-name cap — swap them in for a trustee who is recorded absent.
